notes.title: Join the community on Discord!!!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644501/50d3aa07b3add5e5b356838fc62b4bf04c0bc6c1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hello Berliners, I hope you're all doing well![/b][/p][p][b]I'm hereby inviting you to join the Ollsgar'd community discord! There, we'll not only collect feedback for the game, but also share upcoming releases, events, game art, callouts, and perhaps even announce the Ollsgar'd Grand Championship in the future![/b][/p][p][b]What are you waiting for? Join us on this adventure![/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/ZQzxKSKvmn"]https://discord.gg/ZQzxKSKvmn[/url][/p]
